provenance.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise garment correction.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: the right-facing Karo profile candidate. Image2 is the authoritative original Karo reference. Keep Image1's face, one visible eye, eye/ear positions, beard, hair, warm skin, head size, shoulders, arms/mitten hands, black legs/feet, neutral rest stance, true right-facing view and colors unchanged. Do not lower the ear or redesign the face.
Change ONLY the SHORTS below the belt. They must unmistakably be SHORTS WITH TWO distinct leg openings, matching Image2, not a single dress, apron or hanging triangular tunic flaps. Draw the near shorts leg as a short brown cylindrical hide cuff wrapping around its black stick leg, with an irregular ragged lower rim and a continuous dark ink outline. Show the separate far cuff slightly behind at the correct depth and a clear crotch separation, with its own black leg emerging from its opening. Keep source shorts length, earthy warm brown painted fur texture, narrow cord belt and asymmetry. Do not add bulky muscles, long trousers, leather straps, shoes or a fur shoulder collar.
Both soles remain flat on the same horizontal floor baseline, exactly two arms/two hands/two legs/two feet. Full character visible from every hair tip to both feet, generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent RGBA background, clean edge with no colored haze/ground shadow, no text, scenery, panels, checkerboard or props. Preserve all other artwork, contour details and warm saturation as closely as possible. This correction does not register or approve the image for animation.

reviewNotes: Bản sửa yêu cầu hai cuff riêng và viền quần, không sửa vị trí tai theo góp ý AI chưa đáng tin. Quần/occlusion/tỷ lệ/face/alpha/contact chưa nghiệm thu.
Prompt yêu cầu giữ phần khác, không chứng minh mọi pixel được giữ. Yaw/landmarks/rig/speech/blink/motion còn thiếu.
Canvas height V1=1728, V2=1727; imagegen repair was not pixel-constrained. Do not reuse source coordinates/registration from V1.
